title: Will AI Take YOUR Job? 🤖
description:
Everyone is panicking about the AI apocalypse, but here’s what history tells us. 

This mini history of AI documentary rewinds through three seminal moments when technology reshaped the workforce: the Luddites smashing looms during the Industrial Revolution, the mechanisation of rural farmland and the automation anxiety of the 1960s. 

Will AI actually take your job, or are we living through another chapter in a very old story? 

#AI2026 #AIHistory #HistoryOfAI
